LanguageData.LP_BehirHorn.label: behir horn
LanguageData.LP_BehirHorn.description: A horn from a behir's head that tingles to the touch. Can replace metal for making blades (sharpness ×1.2).
LanguageData.LP_Leather_Behir.label: behir hide
LanguageData.LP_Leather_Behir.description: The blue scaly hide of a behir, tough and resistant to electricity.
LanguageData.LP_BeholderEye.label: beholder central eye
LanguageData.LP_BeholderEye.description: The big central eye of a beholder, still giving off an antimagic glimmer after death. Can be made into an antimagic amulet at the enchanting table.
LanguageData.LP_BeholderStalk.label: beholder eyestalk
LanguageData.LP_BeholderStalk.description: A beholder eyestalk, the little eye at the end still rolling. Wizards use it as a premium ingredient for copying scrolls, and traders pay a good price.
LanguageData.LP_AntiMagicAmulet.label: antimagic amulet
LanguageData.LP_AntiMagicAmulet.description: An amulet made from a beholder's central eye, hung at the waist. Enemies within 3 cells of the wearer can't cast and their shield belts fail; the wearer can't cast either.
LanguageData.LP_SoulGem.label: soul gem
LanguageData.LP_SoulGem.description: A gem from a demilich's eye socket, holding the souls it devoured. A lich using it gives the phylactery 100 sacrifice XP at once. Anyone else smashing it releases the souls: colonists on the map get mood +5 (3 days).
LanguageData.LP_DemilichSkull.label: demilich skull
LanguageData.LP_DemilichSkull.description: A demilich's shattered skull, still holding a thousand years of negative energy. A lich offering it to the phylactery gives the phylactery 300 sacrifice XP at once.
LanguageData.LP_BeholderLairMap.label: beholder lair intel
LanguageData.LP_BeholderLairMap.description: A sketch brought back from the Underdark by a league scout. Reading it reveals a beholder lair on the world map (disappears after 30 days).
LanguageData.LP_TombMap.label: Endless Tomb intel
LanguageData.LP_TombMap.description: An ancient scroll full of warnings, marking a demilich's tomb. Reading it reveals the Endless Tomb on the world map (disappears after 30 days).
